rationale.complete: Round 1 done on 35 non-holdout periods (34 testable, 6-7 identified): card and dated predictions, synthetic validation on 4 real skeletons (8 worlds; A1 fixed before data), coordinator Note N1 recorded before data, replication in two embedding models with raw and window-field variants, cross-fitted information curves, placebo, recency and discrete (semantic_kappa) checks, 3 natives (G51 D2 wakes, NE03, NE42), 216 estimate rows, frozen guarded confirm script (dry-run only).
rationale.faithfulness: HH345's exponent 0.34 is excluded by the pre-set talk-call pool (kill met), but the exogenous-k wake design gives 0.31 [0.25, 0.37], and every identified period excludes both one-message capacity and linear superposition. A topic field alone produces b ~ 0.8, which the placebo rule only partly guards. C 1, D 1, E 1, F 1, H 1.
rationale.usefulness: A usable constant for operators and for H18/H59: total content uptake per call grows as k^0.2-0.3 (ten messages ~ 2x one). Direct instruction: send key messages alone or last; raise cadence rather than batch size.
